item.title: One Issue Hanging Over Brazil’s Presidential Election: Online Gambling and Record-High Debts

media:content.media:credit: Dado Galdieri for The New York Times
media:content.media:description: A storefront offering personal loans in Niteroi, Brazil. Brazil is grappling with widespread household indebtedness, fueled by a combination of easy credit, the rapid expansion of legal and illegal online betting, and instant digital payments that have made borrowing, gambling and spending faster and easier.
